Product Advantage: High-top knitted sock-style upper, easy slip-on construction and segmented foamed sole for casual walking collections.
OEM/ODM Support: Logo, color, size assortment and packaging can be discussed against your design brief and approved sample.
Bulk Order Planning: Production is scheduled after sample and specification approval. The current store reference is 31 days for 100 pairs; final lead time depends on style, material availability, quantity and customization.
Order Quality Confirmation: Materials, colors, size assortment and packing are confirmed before production. Finished goods can be checked against the approved sample and order specifications before shipment.
Start Your Inquiry: MOQ starts from 2 pairs for current store orders. Send your quantity, destination, branding and packaging requirements for a current quotation and sample plan.
